Say.notes: Plain text and the voice attribute map cleanly. Common Twilio voice aliases (alice, man, woman) and Amazon Polly voice names (e.g. Polly.Joanna, Polly.Matthew) are mapped to the nearest BW voice; truly unrecognized voices are dropped rather than passed through, to avoid BW rejecting the call. SSML markup inside Say is preserved: child elements (say-as, emphasis, break, prosody, sub, lang, etc.) pass through to SpeakSentence as raw markup while genuine text is XML-escaped. The tag set is structurally accepted by BW SpeakSentence (validated via `band bxml raw`); BW's TTS renders the standard SSML tags, and any tag it does not act on is ignored rather than failing the call.

voice.notes: Common Twilio/Polly voice names are mapped to the nearest BW equivalent; see TWILIO_TO_BW_VOICE in translate.ts. BW supports 50+ named voices across multiple locales — the full allowlist is in BW_VOICES.

loop.notes: BXML has no loop attribute, so a finite loop="N" is expanded into the SpeakSentence repeated N times. loop="0" (infinite) and invalid counts cannot be expressed inline, so they emit once and warn.

Play.notes: When a src URL is present it maps to PlayAudio. When the digits attribute is present it maps to SendDtmf (BW verb that sends DTMF tones mid-call). Both can appear in the same element: PlayAudio is emitted first, then SendDtmf. Twilio pause characters w (0.5 s), W (1 s), and comma (0.5 s) are passed through to BW SendDtmf unchanged — BW supports the same pause encoding.

loop.notes: BXML has no loop attribute, so a finite loop="N" is expanded into the PlayAudio (and any SendDtmf) repeated N times. loop="0" (infinite) and invalid counts cannot be expressed inline, so they emit once and warn.

digits.notes: Maps to BW SendDtmf verb. Valid chars: 0-9, *, #, a-d, A-D, w (0.5s pause), W (1s pause), comma (0.5s pause).

Gather.notes: DTMF and speech both supported. Per dev.bandwidth.com, BW Gather input accepts dtmf/speech/dtmf_speech.

action.notes: No digits or speech does not request the action; the verbs after the Gather run instead (Twilio semantics). actionOnEmptyResult="true" requests the action with Digits="". A Gather with no action attribute re-requests the current document, matching Twilio, when the server knows the document's URL (standalone BXML generation keeps the original warning instead).

numDigits.notes: Clamped to Bandwidth's 1-50 range with a warning naming the original value; left unset (Bandwidth's own default of 50) when omitted.

timeout.notes: Twilio's single timeout (default 5s) sets both Bandwidth attributes, since Bandwidth splits the pause-before-first-digit and gap-between-digits behavior Twilio combines into one value. Each is clamped independently to its own range (firstDigitTimeout 0-60, interDigitTimeout 1-60) with a warning naming the original value.

finishOnKey.notes: Twilio's default ("#") is emitted explicitly when omitted, since Bandwidth's own default for this attribute is "" (disabled). finishOnKey="" passes through unchanged (both systems treat it as disabled).

input.notes: Twilio dtmf / speech / 'dtmf speech' map to BW input dtmf / speech / dtmf_speech. Speech results arrive as the BW gather event's text field, surfaced to the customer app as Twilio's SpeechResult param.

Redirect.notes: URL moves from element text to redirectUrl attribute.

Reject.notes: Mapped to Hangup; Bandwidth answers before hanging up, so the caller may be billed for a short call.

Record.notes: Recording callback payloads differ; translator normalizes.

action.notes: The callback carries RecordingUrl, RecordingSid, RecordingDuration. Bandwidth's event has no equivalent of Twilio's Digits. A Record with no action attribute re-requests the current document, matching Twilio, when the server knows the document's URL (standalone BXML generation keeps the original warning instead).

recordingStatusCallback.notes: Async 'recording ready' webhook. Translator receives the BW recordingAvailableUrl event, reshapes it into Twilio recordingStatusCallback params, and forwards it; RecordingUrl points back at the translator's recording facade. recordingStatusCallbackMethod=GET is not honored (forwarded via POST).

maxLength.notes: Twilio's default (3600s) is emitted explicitly when omitted, since Bandwidth's own default is 60s. Clamped to Bandwidth's 10800s (3h) maximum with a warning naming the original value.

timeout.notes: Not previously mapped at all, so a recording never stopped on silence; now defaults to Twilio's 5 seconds when omitted and is clamped to Bandwidth's 10800s maximum. timeout="0" (Twilio: disable) and silenceTimeout="0" (Bandwidth: no timeout) agree, so it passes through unchanged.

finishOnKey.notes: Bandwidth's Record takes one terminating digit; Twilio's finishOnKey is a set (default "1234567890*#", any key). A single character passes through unchanged; a multi-character set (including the omitted default) is narrowed to one digit, preferring '#' then '*' then the first character, with a warning.

playBeep.notes: No direct equivalent; translator can prepend a beep PlayAudio later. Twilio's default is true (plays a beep), so a warning is emitted unless playBeep is explicitly "false" (the one value Bandwidth's no-beep behavior matches).

trim.notes: No equivalent; Bandwidth never trims silence. Twilio's default is trim-silence, so a warning is emitted unless trim is explicitly "do-not-trim" (the one value Bandwidth's never-trims behavior matches).

Dial.notes: Number/Sip nouns map to Transfer; Conference noun maps to Conference; Queue and Client nouns are unsupported. answerOnBridge is not replicated. The Dial action receives DialCallStatus and DialBridged mapped from Bandwidth's transfer result, and DialCallSid/DialCallDuration from the dialed leg's transferDisconnect event when it has arrived. When the record attribute is set to a recording-enabled value, a BW StartRecording verb is emitted immediately before the Transfer. Dual-channel variants (record-from-answer-dual, record-from-ringing-dual) emit StartRecording with multiChannel=true.

action.notes: The callback carries DialCallStatus, DialBridged, and (from the dialed leg's transferDisconnect) DialCallSid and DialCallDuration. As on Twilio, a caller hangup during the transfer does not request the action.

record.notes: record-from-answer and record-from-ringing emit a bare StartRecording before Transfer. Dual variants emit StartRecording with multiChannel=true. do-not-record and the default (absent) emit nothing. BW recordingAvailableUrl is not mapped from Twilio's recordingStatusCallback — set it separately if needed.

Start.notes: The Transcription noun under Start maps to BW StartTranscription. statusCallbackUrl maps to transcriptionEventUrl; track (inbound_track/outbound_track/both_legs) maps to BW tracks (inbound/outbound/both). Other Start nouns (Siprec, VirtualAgent) are unsupported. A StopTranscription is NOT automatically emitted — add one explicitly downstream if you need to stop the transcription.

Enqueue.notes: Bandwidth has no queue primitive; contact-center queue flows cannot be translated.

Pay.notes: PCI payment capture is out of scope for the translator.

Refer.notes: Twilio <Refer><Sip> maps to BW <Refer><SipUri>. action maps to referCompleteUrl (rewritten through the translator so the Refer-complete callback returns translated BXML); method maps to referCompleteMethod. Bandwidth honors Refer only on inbound SIP URI calls — a PSTN call leg cannot be REFER'd — so this is partial by platform constraint, not a translation gap. A Refer without a <Sip> child fails loudly (BW Refer accepts only a SIP URI).

Connect.notes: Stream noun maps to StartStream followed by StopStream wait="true", which holds the call open until the bot closes the WebSocket (a bare StartStream ends the call on answer). ConversationRelay and VirtualAgent are unsupported (separate IoV).

Stream.notes: Twilio WS message schema is emulated by the translator's stream bridge; live Bandwidth-side binding requires fixture capture. <Parameter> children become nested <StreamParam/> elements (Bandwidth allows at most 12) and reach the bot as customParameters.

Conference.notes: Basic named conferences work. waitUrl hold music is NOT supported by Bandwidth; beep cues are partial.

waitUrl.notes: No conference hold-music equivalent on Bandwidth.

muted.notes: Twilio muted maps to BW Conference mute.

statusCallback.notes: Twilio conference statusCallback maps to BW conferenceEventUrl; event payloads differ.

startConferenceOnEnter.notes: No verb-level equivalent; BW conference lifecycle is managed via the Conferences REST API, not the BXML verb.

endConferenceOnExit.notes: No verb-level equivalent; manage conference teardown via the BW Conferences REST API.

maxParticipants.notes: No verb-level maxParticipants; not enforced via the BXML Conference verb.

Client.notes: Twilio Client (WebRTC) endpoints have no translator mapping in P0.
